Každá svíčka nese čtyři ceny: open, high: Every candle carries four prices: open, high, low and close (OHLC). The body runs from open to close, the wicks reach to the high and the low.
Timeframe je jen přiblížení. Pět minutov: A timeframe is just a zoom level. Five one-minute candles make one five-minute candle: the open of the first, the close of the last, the highest high and lowest low of all five.
Trend nahoru: každý vrchol je výš než př: Uptrend: every high is higher than the previous one and so is every low. As long as that holds, the structure is bullish.
BOS: svíčka zavře nad posledním vrcholem: BOS: a candle closes above the last high, the trend continues. MSS: a candle closes below the last higher low, the first warning of a change in direction.
Nad stejně vysokými vrcholy leží stop-lo: Stop-losses sit above equal highs. A sweep is a wick that takes them out, and the candle then closes back below the level. In a breakout it would close above it.
Velká svíčka (displacement) nechá mezeru: A large candle (displacement) leaves a gap between the high of the first candle and the low of the third. That is an FVG. Price later returns to its midpoint and continues in the original direction.
Pohyb ode dna k vrcholu se rozdělí v půl: The move from the low to the high is split in half. You should buy in the lower half (discount) and sell in the upper half (premium).
Bullish order block: poslední klesající: Bullish order block: the last down candle before a strong rally. When price returns to it, ICT looks for a buy there.
Den v newyorském čase. Svislé čáry jsou: The day in New York time. The vertical lines are the midnight opening price, the 8:30 data and the 9:30 market open. Below them you see the killzones, the three one-hour Silver Bullet windows and the Tape model window.
Bias je odpověď na otázku, ke které likv: Bias answers the question of which liquidity price is most likely heading to. Here it rises to the previous day's high, so the bias is long.

Graf má dvě osy a většina lidí řeší jen: A chart has two axes and most people only deal with price. This view says that when something happens matters just as much. A setup carries more weight when the right price meets the right time. When the time doesn't fit, it is a weaker opportunity, even if the pattern looks textbook.
Na high a low záleží podle toho, kdy vzn: Highs and lows matter by when they formed
Staré high nebo low samo o sobě moc nezn: An old high or low means little on its own. What matters is the time span it formed in. The high and low of the previous session or the previous cycle act as magnets for price in the next one. The longer the span, the more liquidity builds up at its edges and the more weight the level has.
Den se dá rozdělit na cykly po 30, 60, 9: The day can be split into cycles of 30, 60, 90 and 240 minutes. A ninety-minute cycle consists of three thirty-minute ones and each of them can have its own small sequence of accumulation, manipulation and distribution. The trade target is usually the high or low of the previous cycle.
Manipulace se měří od otevírací ceny cyk: Manipulation is measured from the cycle's opening price. When you expect a drop, you first want to see a false move above the opening price, where the cycle high forms, and only then the move down. For a rally it is mirrored: first a push below the opening price, then the rise. Without manipulation there is no setup.
Nahromadění, manipulace, distribuce. Man: Accumulation, manipulation, distribution. The manipulation is also called the Judas swing. The point is that it can be expected at specific times, typically at the market open at 9:30 New York time and then around 10:00 and 14:00. When the false move doesn't come at that time, the session carries less weight.
Dopolední okno trvá od 7:00 do 12:00 new: The morning window runs from 7:00 to 12:00 New York time and can be split into half-hours, each of which tends to have its own character. Before the 8:30 news the market often just treads water and collects liquidity. The cycle around lunch (11:30 to 13:00) tends to be consolidation or a retracement and is not traded. Its high and low then serve as a target for the afternoon (13:00 to 16:00).
Vyber si jedno časové okno a jeden opaku: Pick one time window and one recurring event, for example the 9:30 push against the day's direction. Watch it for weeks and write down exactly when what happened. You don't have to sit at the chart all day, it is enough to be there at the moment your setup can come.
